sloka: इमानि शुभ गन्धीनि पश्य लक्ष्मण सर्वशः ।नलिनानि प्रकाशन्ते जले तरुण सूर्य वत् ॥४-१-६२॥
transliteration: imāni śubha gandhīni paśya lakṣmaṇa sarvaśaḥ ।nalināni prakāśante jale taruṇa sūrya vat ॥4-1-62॥

translations.english: 'This Pampa with its water clear and fragrant with red and blue lotuses is filled with swans and geese.
